style.name: Victorian
style.description: Victorian-era design encompassed many movements and revivals rather than one uniform style. A contemporary Victorian-inspired interface often draws on ornate borders, decorative lettering, engraved imagery, and richly framed compositions.

fonts.heading: UnifrakturMaguntia
fonts.rationale: Blackletter offers a deliberately Gothic-inspired accent within the broader Victorian reference; the serif body face suits short editorial passages.

tips: Choose a specific historical reference to guide ornament.
Reserve elaborate lettering for short headings.
Simplify borders and framing on small screens.
avoid: Treating all nineteenth-century styles as identical.
Blackletter for navigation or long paragraphs.
Ornament that competes with the content.
